features.title: Bounded compaction summaries
features.summary: Summarizes oversized conversation history in bounded, tool-balanced requests before the native durable compaction transaction commits. A request the provider still rejects as too large is retried with older tool outputs and exchanges shortened (the newest exchange intact) before it is split.
failureModes: A system prompt, tool catalog, or one indivisible tool transaction with nothing long enough to shorten can exceed the safe request budget; compaction fails without rewriting the session history.
Shortened tool outputs and older exchange text keep only their first 1,024 and last 512 characters in the summary request, so the summary can miss detail from their middle.
An image-bearing request without model-declared image pricing cannot be safely sized and fails before dispatch.

A failure that the same history and request prefix reproduce (the budget refusals above, a route without image pricing) is attempted once; pressure compaction then waits until a compaction rewrites the history or the route or tool catalog changes.

verification.testName: splits oversized input while keeping tool calls with their results
answers a provider overflow by shortening older tool outputs and keeping the newest exchange intact
does not retry, on every step, a compaction whose summary request can never fit

verification.reason: This Host-only backend has no browser-owned surface; its behavior is verified through unit tests and a scratch profile boot.

features.title: Background compaction summaries
features.summary: Opt-in: once a thread nears its compaction threshold, the engine summarizes the span the next compaction would replace beside the running turn, then commits it instantly at the threshold if that span is unchanged. Off by default: a summary the conversation moves past is a billed request thrown away.
features.currentSurface: host: agent pre-step listener, no UI

configuration.constraints: Each background summary is a billed compaction request on the thread's Session, counted whether applied or discarded; turn it on only after a measurement.
Fraction of the compaction threshold, in (0, 1), at which the summary starts.

failureModes: A prepared summary whose span changed (a manual compaction, pruning, an earlier compaction) is discarded and the compaction runs as usual; its request still counts toward the Session's cost.
A failed background request is logged; the automatic compaction then summarizes as usual and the next background attempt waits for the next surface generation.
A prepared span that alone does not bring the thread under its threshold is followed by the usual blocking compaction.

verification.testName: applies a summary prepared in the background without a compaction request at the threshold
never applies a prepared summary to a span it did not summarize

verification.reason: This Host-only engine behavior has no browser surface; a real agent loop drives it in the engine integration tests.

telemetry.testName: applies a summary prepared in the background without a compaction request at the threshold

features.title: Loaded skills kept in compaction checkpoints
features.summary: Opt-in: each checkpoint lists the skills the span it replaces loaded (and, in bodies mode, keeps their instructions), so a long thread does not reload a skill only because a compaction dropped it. Off by default: the kept block adds tokens to every later request.
features.currentSurface: host: appended to the checkpoint summary, no UI

configuration.constraints: names adds one line per loaded skill to each checkpoint; bodies also keeps their instructions, up to 32,000 characters per checkpoint.

failureModes: A skill result the tool-result pruner already shortened keeps only its shortened text in bodies mode.
Skills past the 32,000-character budget keep only their name and directory.

verification.testName: carries the skills an earlier checkpoint kept into the next one

verification.reason: This Host-only checkpoint text has no browser surface; unit tests drive it on replayed messages.

telemetry.reason: Pure text assembly inside the summary the existing context compaction summarize span already covers; no I/O of its own.

features.title: Provider context-overflow recognition
features.summary: Recognizes context-overflow failures the core does not code as CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED (Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, llama.cpp, xAI, Moonshot, Copilot, GLM, Cohere wording, along the cause chain) and gives them the stock recovery: one overflow compaction, then a retry. Also ignores a compaction headroom buffer that would leave the model no pressure budget.
features.currentSurface: host: agent request-error listener, no UI
failureModes: A provider wording outside the list still fails the turn as before; add it to src/context-overflow.ts.
Recovery stops after maxOverflowRetries per turn and the original request error is kept.

verification.testName: recovers from a provider overflow the core does not code as CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED
compacts a route whose headroom buffer leaves no room

verification.reason: This Host-only recovery has no browser surface; a real agent loop drives it in the engine integration tests.

features.title: Idle compaction before cache expiry
features.summary: An opt-in Host timer compacts a large thread that has sat idle for most of its prompt-cache lifetime, so the next message does not re-send the whole prompt uncached. It only trusts activity this Host observed itself, attempts once per idle stretch and never after expiry. Off by default: each compaction is one billed request.

configuration.constraints: `off` or `compact`; warm is unavailable until a prefix-identical ping can be charged to the Session (Host gap 108).
A thread below this prompt size is left alone.
The cache lifetime the thread's route asks for; 60 with cacheRetention long. No compaction runs once it has expired.
How long before the lifetime ends to compact.

failureModes: The sweep lists the newest 200 visible threads; a larger history leaves older threads alone until they move back into that window.
A running thread is skipped, and a live Agent that gained a turn or queued input is rechecked and skipped immediately before the billed request.
A failed compaction is logged and not retried for the same idle stretch, so a provider failure cannot bill that thread again.
A compaction's own checkpoint message is not treated as new activity, so it cannot arm the next sweep.
No compaction runs after the cache lifetime has expired: the next prompt is already uncached, so it would save nothing.
A thread this Host never observed active, including every thread at startup, is skipped until it emits new activity. The thread list's last-prompt time is never used as an idle start.
A warm ping is unavailable: a prefix-identical replay cannot be charged to the Session's cost total without a Host side-call usage event (Host gap 108), so only off and compact are accepted.

verification.testName: is due only shortly before the cache lifetime ends
never compacts after the cache lifetime expired, when the next prompt is already uncached
skips a thread whose idle start this Host never observed, with no fallback timestamp
bills a failed attempt once per idle stretch instead of retrying every sweep
does not arm another attempt from a compaction checkpoint it wrote itself
compacts only the threads due, once per idle stretch, and records its span

verification.reason: This Host-only timer has no browser-owned surface; its timing and span are verified by unit tests and a scratch profile boot.

features.title: Next automatic compaction for a thread
features.summary: The threshold API (agent tool compaction_threshold) returns the token count at which automatic compaction next runs for one live thread: the running engine's policy, the thread's routed model and context window, its output reservation, and the engine's own pressure reading. A headroom buffer that leaves no pressure budget is ignored, as the engine ignores it. agent-plan shows it beside the composer's context meter.
features.currentSurface: host: threshold API and agent tool
failureModes: The route's model info lookup can fail; the API returns compaction-threshold-failure naming the route to fix in Settings › Models.

verification.testName: reads the running engine policy, the routed output cap and the meter for a live thread

verification.reason: This Host API has no browser surface of its own; the agent-plan.compaction-meter journey drives it through the agent-plan chip.
